title: Device inventory and compliance report
description: Enrolled devices, owner, OS version, compliance state, reconciled to personnel roster.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: EDR coverage and alert disposition
description: Coverage percentage of managed devices, agent health, alerts and dispositions with times.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Disk encryption status and lost device records
description: Per-device encryption status and key escrow; lost/stolen reports with wipe confirmation.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Conditional access decisions
description: Authentication attempts with device compliance outcome; denied unmanaged-device access to restricted applications.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Agent sandbox configuration attestation
description: For each approved agent platform: credential scope, token lifetime, egress policy, branch protection settings, and periodic verification results.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Agent provenance records
description: Per agent execution: agent id, provider, model, runtime, reason, operations and affected files or commits.
producer: Praxis (exists for repository work; not operated for a production service)
format: YAML front matter and Praxis execution records
signing: none today; proposed signing not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)
